notes: This paper reports potato tuber yield for 5 cultivars (Irga, Satina, Valfi, Blaue St. Galler, Highland Burgundy Red) across 3 years (2013, 2014, 2015) with 3 treatments (Asahi SL biostimulator, Bio-Algeen S-90 SWE, Kelpak SWE) and a control. Li 2022 included only 6 GT rows for Bio-Algeen S-90 and Kelpak (not Asahi SL), with 3 distinct control means (2.5379, 1.25, 1.7803 t/ha). These three control means do not match any single cultivar/year combination in the JSON (which range from 5630 to 40041 kg/ha), and none convert to the GT values by a simple factor. This strongly suggests Li 2022 extracted data from three separate yield categories (e.g., total tuber yield, marketable yield, and small tuber yield, or yield per plant vs. per area) that this paper reported separately. Our extractor captured only generic 'potato yield' without distinguishing these sub-categories. Additionally, our extractor included all 5 cultivars and all 3 years individually (15 obs per treatment), while the GT apparently used specific aggregates or sub-categories. Result: 6/6 GT rows unmatched (coverage failure due to yield sub-category distinction), 45/45 JSON obs unmatched. The 30 Asahi SL JSON obs are additionally outside Li 2022's scope for this paper.
